# Generate cormat for original parameters

```{r}
cormat <- round(cor(AsymLR.ParamDf[2:5]),2)
library(reshape2)
melted_cormat <- melt(cormat)
  get_lower_tri<-function(cormat){
    cormat[upper.tri(cormat)] <- NA
    return(cormat)
  }
  # Get upper triangle of the correlation matrix
  get_upper_tri <- function(cormat){
    cormat[lower.tri(cormat)]<- NA
    return(cormat)
  }
reorder_cormat <- function(cormat){
# Use correlation between variables as distance
dd <- as.dist((1-cormat)/2)
hc <- hclust(dd)
cormat <-cormat[hc$order, hc$order]
}

upper_tri <- get_upper_tri(cormat)
# Melt the correlation matrix
melted_cormat <- melt(upper_tri, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a ggheatmap
ggheatmap <- ggplot(melted_cormat, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value))+
 geom_tile(color = "white")+
 scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", 
   midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1,1), space = "Lab", 
    name="Pearson\nCorrelation") +
  theme_minimal()+ # minimal theme
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, 
    size = 25, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text( 
    size = 25) )+
 coord_fixed()

greekLab <- c(expression(alpha[p]), expression(alpha[n]), expression(phi), expression(beta) )

OrigOrigHeatMap <- ggheatmap + 
geom_text(aes(Var2, Var1, label = value), color = "black", size = 4) +
theme(
  axis.title.x = element_text(size=18, face="bold"),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size=18, face="bold"),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  legend.justification = c(1, 0),
  legend.position = c(0.48, 0.7),
  legend.direction = "horizontal")+
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 7, barheight = 1,
                title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) + xlab("Original") + ylab("Original") +
  scale_x_discrete(
        labels=greekLab)  +
  scale_y_discrete(
        labels=greekLab)

# Fit original parameters

```{r}

  set.seed(132)
  fullDf <- fullDf[!is.na(fullDf$selfRespT1),] # Remove missing responses; data will not fit with missing responses included
  fullDf <- fullDf[order(fullDf$subID, fullDf$trialTotalT1),] # Sort by trials for trial-by-trial learning
  uIds <- unique(fullDf$subID)
  x = c("subID", "posLR", "negLR", "Decay", "slope", "LL", "k", "n", "BIC", "AIC")
  k = 4

  core<-detectCores()
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(core-2, setup_strategy = "sequential")
  setDefaultCluster(cl=cl)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  clusterExport(cl, list("cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("x"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("k"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("fullDf"))
  
result<-foreach(i=uIds, .combine = rbind.data.frame, .export=c('cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA', 'cOptimx', 'fullDf', 'x', 'k'), .packages = c("compiler", "optimx")) %dopar% {
  paramDf <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(x) ))
  names(paramDf) <- x
  subDf <- subset(fullDf, subID == i) # Subset participant data
  SSE <- function(param){ sum((subDf$selfRespT1  -                              (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialTotalT1,subDf$clustType,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2) } # Set objective function for SSE
  #  SSE <- function(param){ (sum((subDf$Value  - (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialNum,subDf$feat,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2)) + lambda * sum( c( ( zScore(param[1], priorsM[1], priorsSD[1] ) )^2, ( zScore(param[2], priorsM[2], priorsSD[2] ) )^2, (  zScore(param[3], priorsM[3], priorsSD[3] ) )^2, (  zScore(param[4], priorsM[4], priorsSD[4] ) )^2 )) } # Set objective function for SSE
  (output <- optimx(par = c(.04, .04, .99, 1), method = c("L-BFGS-B"), fn = SSE, lower = c(0, 0, .7, .5), upper = c(1,1,1,9 ))) # Set parameters for optimization
  paramDf$subID <- i
  paramDf$posLR <- output$p1
  paramDf$negLR <- output$p2
  paramDf$Decay <- output$p3
  paramDf$slope <- output$p4
  paramDf$k <- k
  paramDf$n <- nrow(subDf)
  paramDf$LL <- output$value
  paramDf$BIC <- nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf)) + k * log(nrow(subDf)) # Compute BIC
  paramDf$AIC <- 2 * k + nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf))
  paramDf
    
}
stopCluster(cl)  
AsymLR.ParamDf <- result
```

# Generate simulated parameters

```{r}
set.seed(52)

iter<-250

posLRseq<-seq(from = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$posLR)[2], to = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$posLR)[4], length.out = 5)
negLRseq<-seq(from = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$negLR)[2], to = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$negLR)[4], length.out = 5)
decayseq <-seq(from = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$Decay)[2], to = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$Decay)[4], length.out = 5)
fsseq <-seq(from = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$slope)[2], to = quantile(AsymLR.ParamDf$slope)[4], length.out = 5)

posLRnoised <- c()
negLRnoised <- c()
decaynoised <- c()
fsnoised <- c()
boundedD <- function(param){
  if(param>1){
    param <- 1
  } else if(param<0){
    param <- 0
  }
  return(param)
}
boundedS <- function(param){
  if(param>10){
    param <- 9
  } else if(param<0.5){
    param <- 0.5
  }
  return(param)
}
boundedLR <- function(param){
  if(param>1){
    param <- 1
  } else if(param<0){
    param <- 0
  }
  return(param)
}
for(i in 1:5){
  for(k in 1:(iter/5)){
    
    posLRnoised <- c(posLRnoised, boundedLR(rnorm(1, posLRseq[i], sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$posLR) )) )
    negLRnoised <- c(negLRnoised, boundedLR(rnorm(1, negLRseq[i], sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$negLR) )) )
    decaynoised <- c(decaynoised, boundedD(rnorm(1, decayseq[i], sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$Decay) )) )
    fsnoised <- c(fsnoised, boundedS( fsseq[i] + runif(1, -sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$slope)*2, sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$slope)*2 ) ))

  }
}
seqParams <- data.frame(posLR = sample(posLRnoised, iter, replace = F), negLR = sample(negLRnoised, iter, replace = F), decay = sample(decaynoised, iter, replace = F), slope = sample(fsnoised, iter, replace = F))

hist(seqParams$posLR, breaks =50)
hist(seqParams$negLR, breaks = 50)
hist(seqParams$decay, breaks = 50)
hist(seqParams$slope, breaks = 50)
```
# Generate behavioral data from simulated parameters

```{r}
x<-c('trialNum', 'w1','w2','w3','w4','w5','RPE','Value', 'cluster', 'prob', 'clustType', 'valence', 'feedback', 'i')
simulated<-as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=length(x)))
names(simulated) <- x
simParams <- matrix(ncol=5)
set.seed(42)
for(i in 1:iter){
  
  sampParams<-c(seqParams$posLR[i], seqParams$negLR[i], seqParams$decay[i], seqParams$slope[i])
  curSim<-cTD.AsymLRDecaySA_paramRecov(sampParams)
  sampParams<-c(sampParams, i)
  curSim <- cbind(curSim, i)
  simulated<-rbind(simulated, curSim)
  simParams<-rbind(simParams, sampParams)
  
}
simulated<-simulated[2:nrow(simulated),1:ncol(simulated)]
simParams<-simParams[2:nrow(simParams),1:ncol(simParams)]

simulated<-as.data.frame(simulated)
simParams<-as.data.frame(simParams)
names(simParams) <- c("posLR","negLR","decay","slope","simID")
names(simulated)[colnames(simulated)=="i"] <- "simID"
```

# Iterate from lambda = .05 to lambda = 1 to find lambda best recovery

```{r}
lambdaList <- seq(from=.05,to=1,by=.05)
matPerform <- matrix(ncol=2, nrow=length(lambdaList))

for(iteration in 1:length(lambdaList)){
  lambda <- lambdaList[iteration]

  set.seed(132)
  simulated <- simulated[!is.na(simulated$Value),] # Remove missing responses; data will not fit with missing responses included
  simulated <- simulated[order(simulated$simID, simulated$trialNum),] # Sort by trials for trial-by-trial learning
  simIds <- unique(simulated$simID)
  x = c("simID", "posLR", "negLR", "decay", "slope", "LL", "k", "n", "BIC", "AIC")
  k = 4

    core<-detectCores()
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(core-2, setup_strategy = "sequential")
  setDefaultCluster(cl=cl)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  clusterExport(cl, list("cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("x"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("k"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("simulated"))
  
result<-foreach(i=simIds, .combine = rbind.data.frame, .export=c('cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA', 'cOptimx', 'fullDf', 'x', 'k'), .packages = c("compiler", "optimx", "scales")) %dopar% {
  paramDf <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(x)))
  names(paramDf) <- x
  subDf <- subset(simulated, simID == i) # Subset participant data
  SSE <- function(param){ (sum((subDf$Value  - (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialNum,subDf$clustType,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2)) } # Set objective function for SSE
  
  (output <- optimx(par = c(.04, .04, .99, 1), method = c("L-BFGS-B"), fn = SSE, lower = c(0, 0, 0.7, 0.5), upper = c(1,1,1, 9))) # Set parameters for optimization
  paramDf$simID <- i
  paramDf$posLR <- output$p1
  paramDf$negLR <- output$p2
  paramDf$decay <- output$p3
  paramDf$slope <- output$p4
  paramDf$k <- k
  paramDf$n <- nrow(subDf)
  paramDf$LL <- output$value
  paramDf$BIC <- nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf)) + k * log(nrow(subDf)) # Compute BIC
  paramDf$AIC <- 2 * k + nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf))
  paramDf
    
}
stopCluster(cl)
OLS <- result

  priorsM <- c(mean(OLS$posLR), mean(OLS$negLR), mean(OLS$decay), mean(OLS$slope))
  priorsSD <- c(sd(OLS$posLR), sd(OLS$negLR), sd(OLS$decay), sd(OLS$slope))
  
  core<-detectCores()

  clusterExport(cl, list("simulated"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("priorsM"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("priorsSD"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("lambda"))
  
result<-foreach(i=simIds, .combine = rbind.data.frame, .export=c('cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA', 'cOptimx', 'fullDf', 'x', 'k', 'priorsM', 'priorsSD', 'lambda', 'zScore'), .packages = c("compiler", "optimx", "scales")) %dopar% {
  paramDf <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(x)))
  names(paramDf) <- x
  subDf <- subset(simulated, simID == i) # Subset participant data
  SSE <- function(param){ (sum((subDf$Value  - (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialNum,subDf$clustType,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2)) + lambda * sum( c( ( zScore(param[1], priorsM[1], priorsSD[1] ) )^2, ( zScore(param[2], priorsM[2], priorsSD[2] ) )^2, (  zScore(param[3], priorsM[3], priorsSD[3] ) )^2, (  zScore(param[4], priorsM[4], priorsSD[4] ) )^2 )) } # Set objective function for SSE

# Retaining original covariance structure: Generate behavioral data with original parameters

```{r}
x<-c('trialNum', 'w1','w2','w3','w4','w5','RPE','Value', 'cluster', 'prob', 'clustType', 'valence', 'feedback', 'subID')
simulated2<-as.data.frame(matrix(ncol=length(x)))
names(simulated2) <- x
simParams2 <- matrix(ncol=5)
set.seed(42)
for(i in 1:length(uIds)){
  
  sampParams2<-c(AsymLR.ParamDf$posLR[i], AsymLR.ParamDf$negLR[i], AsymLR.ParamDf$Decay[i], AsymLR.ParamDf$slope[i])
  curSim<-cTD.AsymLRDecaySA_paramRecov(sampParams2)
  subID <- uIds[i]
  sampParams2<-c(sampParams2, subID)
  curSim <- cbind(curSim, subID)
  simulated2<-rbind(simulated2, curSim)
  simParams2<-rbind(simParams, sampParams2)
}
simulated2<-simulated2[2:nrow(simulated2),1:ncol(simulated2)]
simParams2<-simParams2[2:nrow(simParams2),1:ncol(simParams2)]

simulated2<-as.data.frame(simulated2)
simParams2<-as.data.frame(simParams2)
names(simParams2) <- c("posLR","negLR","decay","slope","subID")
```

  names(paramDf) <- x
  subDf <- subset(simulated2, subID == i) # Subset participant data
  SSE <- function(param){ (sum((subDf$Value  - (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialNum,subDf$clustType,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2)) } # Set objective function for SSE
  (output <- optimx(par = c(.04, .04, .99, 1), method = c("L-BFGS-B"), fn = SSE, lower = c(0, 0, .7, .5), upper = c(1,1,1,9 ))) # Set parameters for optimization
  paramDf$subID <- i
  paramDf$posLR <- output$p1
  paramDf$negLR <- output$p2
  paramDf$Decay <- output$p3
  paramDf$slope <- output$p4
  paramDf$k <- k
  paramDf$n <- nrow(subDf)
  paramDf$LL <- output$value
  paramDf$BIC <- nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf)) + k * log(nrow(subDf)) # Compute BIC
  paramDf$AIC <- 2 * k + nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf))
  paramDf
    
}
stopCluster(cl)  
Fitted.ParamDf2 <- result
```

# Fitting to behavior generated by original parameters (Ridge)

```{r}

  set.seed(132)
  simulated2 <- simulated2[!is.na(simulated2$Value),] # Remove missing responses; data will not fit with missing responses included
  simulated2 <- simulated2[order(simulated2$subID, simulated2$trialNum),] # Sort by trials for trial-by-trial learning
  simIds <- unique(simulated2$subID)
  x = c("subID", "posLR", "negLR", "decay", "slope", "LL", "k", "n", "BIC", "AIC")
  k = 4
  
  priorsM <- c(mean(Fitted.ParamDf2$posLR), mean(Fitted.ParamDf2$negLR), mean(Fitted.ParamDf2$Decay), mean(Fitted.ParamDf2$slope))
  priorsSD <- c(sd(Fitted.ParamDf2$posLR), sd(Fitted.ParamDf2$negLR), sd(Fitted.ParamDf2$Decay), sd(Fitted.ParamDf2$slope))
  lambda <- .15
  # priorsM <- c(mean(AsymLR.ParamDf$posLR), mean(AsymLR.ParamDf$negLR), mean(AsymLR.ParamDf$Decay), mean(AsymLR.ParamDf$slope))
  # priorsSD <- c(sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$posLR), sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$negLR), sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$Decay), sd(AsymLR.ParamDf$slope))

  core<-detectCores()
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(core-2, setup_strategy = "sequential")
  setDefaultCluster(cl=cl)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  clusterExport(cl, list("cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("x"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("k"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("simulated2"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("priorsM"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("priorsSD"))
  clusterExport(cl, list("lambda"))
  
result<-foreach(i=uIds, .combine = rbind.data.frame, .export=c('cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA', 'cOptimx', 'fullDf', 'x', 'k', 'priorsM', 'priorsSD', 'lambda', 'zScore'), .packages = c("compiler", "optimx")) %dopar% {
  paramDf <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(x)))
  names(paramDf) <- x
  subDf <- subset(simulated2, subID == i) # Subset participant data
  SSE <- function(param){ (sum((subDf$Value  - (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialNum,subDf$clustType,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2)) + lambda * sum( c( ( zScore(param[1], priorsM[1], priorsSD[1] ) )^2, ( zScore(param[2], priorsM[2], priorsSD[2] ) )^2, (  zScore(param[3], priorsM[3], priorsSD[3] ) )^2, (  zScore(param[4], priorsM[4], priorsSD[4] ) )^2 )) } # Set objective function for SSE
  (output <- optimx(par = c(.04, .04, .99, 1), method = c("L-BFGS-B"), fn = SSE, lower = c(0, 0, 0, .5), upper = c(1,1,1,9 ))) # Set parameters for optimization
  
  #SSE <- function(param){ sum((subDf$Value  - (cTD.AsymLR_NewD_SA(subDf$trialNum,subDf$clustType,subDf$feedback,4,sigP=c(1,0),param)$Value))^2) } # Set objective function for SSE
  
  #(output <- optimx(par = c(.04, .04, .99, 1), method = c("L-BFGS-B"), fn = SSE, lower = c(0, 0, .5, .5), upper = c(1,1,1, 10))) # Set parameters for optimization
  paramDf$simID <- i
  paramDf$posLR <- output$p1
  paramDf$negLR <- output$p2
  paramDf$decay <- output$p3
  paramDf$slope <- output$p4
  paramDf$k <- k
  paramDf$n <- nrow(subDf)
  paramDf$LL <- output$value
  paramDf$BIC <- nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf)) + k * log(nrow(subDf)) # Compute BIC
  paramDf$AIC <- 2 * k + nrow(subDf) * log(output$value/nrow(subDf))
  paramDf
    
}
stopCluster(cl)

# Time 2 evaluations with simulated behavior

```{r}
set.seed(11)
simulated2 <- simulated2[order(simulated2$subID, simulated2$clustType, simulated2$trialNum),]
uIds <- unique(simulated2$subID)
uClust <- unique(simulated2$clustType)
simulated2$T2eval <- NA
for(i in uIds){
  subDf <- simulated2[simulated2$subID==i,]
  for(j in uClust){
    clustDf <- subDf[subDf$clustType==j,]
    maxTrial <- max(clustDf$trialNum)
    column <- (grep("trialNum",colnames(simulated2)) + j)
    maxVal <- clustDf[clustDf$trialNum == maxTrial, column]
    simulated2$T2eval[simulated2$subID == i & simulated2$clustType==j] <- round(maxVal)
  }
}
simulated2 <- simulated2[order(simulated2$subID, simulated2$trialNum),]
psych::describeBy(simulated2$T2eval, simulated2$clustType)
```

# Correlations between simulated (generated by original) and original

```{r}
cormat <- round(corTrueSim$r,2)
cormat <- cormat[1:4,5:8]
library(reshape2)
melted_cormat <- melt(cormat)
  get_lower_tri<-function(cormat){
    cormat[upper.tri(cormat)] <- NA
    return(cormat)
  }
  # Get upper triangle of the correlation matrix
  get_upper_tri <- function(cormat){
    cormat[lower.tri(cormat)]<- NA
    return(cormat)
  }
reorder_cormat <- function(cormat){
# Use correlation between variables as distance
dd <- as.dist((1-cormat)/2)
hc <- hclust(dd)
cormat <-cormat[hc$order, hc$order]
}

#cormat <- reorder_cormat(cormat)
upper_tri <- get_upper_tri(cormat)
# Melt the correlation matrix
melted_cormat <- melt(upper_tri, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a ggheatmap
ggheatmap <- ggplot(melted_cormat, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value))+
 geom_tile(color = "white")+
 scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", 
   midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1,1), space = "Lab", 
    name="Pearson\nCorrelation") +
  theme_minimal()+ # minimal theme
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1,

 coord_fixed()
